about.label: ABOUT ME
about.title: I'd rather a system be tested
about.bio1: I did two internships at TechPal on technologies I had never used. With Odoo 17, I shipped an internship-management ERP the HR team still uses. With Odoo and Flutter, a 9-module e-commerce platform and its mobile app.
about.bio2: On the side, I build projects that go past what courses cover: banking microservices with idempotent transfers and 205 tests, a RAG assistant that cites its sources, and JobPilot, a job-search SaaS. I'm looking for a backend or full-stack Java role in Casablanca, hybrid or remote.

agentFlow.title: AgentFlow
agentFlow.description: Five LangGraph agents analyze a data file and write a report. The Python they generate runs in an isolated subprocess and fixes its own errors, up to 3 attempts. A deterministic checker compares the report with the figures actually computed, and each visitor sees only their own tasks. Ollama locally, Groq for the live demo.
